text: Zik looked down at the journal as the final line finished writing itself, the ink drawing out each letter with excruciating deliberation:
speaker: Narrator

text: ONE OF YOU WAS NEVER SENT.
speaker: Narrator
note: Written text (ledger/inscription/journal, not in Bel-iddin's hand). Cold, deliberate read.

text: The chamber seemed to contract around them. The walls leaned inward as if to hear better. Ninsun made a small, strangled sound. Enhedu's earlier detachment cracked into something closer to alarm. Balag's face had gone the color of old ash.
speaker: Narrator

text: From inside the pack came a fourth knock.
speaker: Narrator
